```plato

// A Lissajous figure: x = XAmplitude * sin(2 * pi * XFrequency * t + Phase),
// y = YAmplitude * sin(2 * pi * YFrequency * t). Closes when the frequency
// ratio is rational; the canonical parameter covers one combined period
// (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lissajous_curve).
type Lissajous2D
    implements ICurve2D
{
    XAmplitude: Number;
    YAmplitude: Number;
    XFrequency: Number;
    YFrequency: Number;
    Phase: Angle;
}
```
